protocol: train-only PixLoc multi-scale feature adaptation with LiDAR-fitted finite patches from the complete train visual map and a single shared six-DoF pose
training_split: manifest split=train only; 47 train rows; query GT loaded only by pose loss

pretrained_pixloc.trainable: the three official feature adaptation layers only; VGG19 encoder, decoder and confidence layers frozen

pose_alignment.pose_bounds: ±0.1 m and ±1 degree about the LEADER pose
pose_alignment.feature_loss: PixLoc normalized descriptor residual with official scaled Barron alpha=0, c=0.1 form and frozen PixLoc uncertainty maps
pose_alignment.surface_patch_normalization: feature samples are averaged per patch so sample count does not multiply patch weight
pose_alignment.lidar_prior: single existing frame-level quadratic information prior; shared across all cameras and scales
